evals.prompt: set up a budget alert for our monthly cloud spend
evals.expected_output: Ties alerts to forecasted trajectory rather than only the final month-end total, e.g. an informational alert at 50% consumed by day 10 and a page when forecasted to exceed budget by more than 10%, so the team has runway to act mid-cycle.

evals.prompt: we got blindsided by a huge invoice at the end of the month
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses that alerts only fired on the final month-end total instead of forecasted trajectory, and recommends trend-based forecasting adjusted for known upcoming changes plus rate-of-change anomaly detection per cost category so overruns surface mid-cycle.

evals.prompt: let's skip showback and just start charging teams for their cloud usage now
evals.expected_output: Pushes back that chargeback before showback turns every dispute into a fight about tag accuracy, and recommends letting teams see and validate their own showback numbers first to build trust before switching on chargeback.
